arguments.code:
# Fetch spotify song library (all pages)

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
song_lib = []

while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_song_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    song_lib.extend(resp)
    print('song_lib page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    page_index += 1

print('song_lib total', len(song_lib))
# Build initial mapping from song_id -> (title, artists_str, artist_names)

song_map = {}
for s in song_lib:
    song_id = s['song_id']
    artists = [a['name'] for a in s.get('artists', [])]
    artists_str = '|'.join(artists)
    song_map[song_id] = {'title': s['title'], 'artists': artists, 'artists_str': artists_str}

print('unique songs from song library', len(song_map))

# Continue backup: fetch album library songs

page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
album_lib = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_album_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    album_lib.extend(resp)
    print('album_lib page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
    page_index += 1
print('album_lib total', len(album_lib))

album_song_ids = set()
for a in album_lib:
    for sid in a.get('song_ids', []):
        album_song_ids.add(sid)
print('unique song_ids from album library', len(album_song_ids))

# fetch playlist library (public and private)

def fetch_playlists(is_public):
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    out=[]
    while True:
        resp = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, is_public=is_public, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
        if not resp:
            break
        out.extend(resp)
        print('playlist_lib is_public', is_public, 'page', page_index, 'count', len(resp))
        page_index += 1
    return out

playlists_public = fetch_playlists(True)
playlists_private = fetch_playlists(False)

all_playlists = playlists_public + playlists_private
print('playlists total (public+private)', len(all_playlists))

playlist_song_ids = set()
for p in all_playlists:
    for sid in p.get('song_ids', []):
        playlist_song_ids.add(sid)
print('unique song_ids from playlists', len(playlist_song_ids))

# union of all song_ids requested
requested_song_ids = set(song_map.keys()) | album_song_ids | playlist_song_ids
print('total unique song_ids for backup', len(requested_song_ids))
